# Copilot instructions

The canonical instructions for AI agents working on this repository live in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root. **Read that file.**

It covers:

- What the repo is and how the three layers (simulator, Klipper plugin,
  ESP32-S3 firmware) relate.
- Build and validation commands (PlatformIO env names, `pio run -d firmware`).
- The CI / release pipeline behaviour and constraints.
- Project layout, key files for each common change type, and gotchas to
  not regress.
- Conventional-commit and signing requirements.

Trust those instructions before falling back to repo-wide search.
